description: 刀を腰の横に掛け、柄ではなく鞘の上部をつかむ形へ修正。
prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this exact chibi Yamato Takeru. Required correction: his sword currently seems to enter his abdomen. REMOVE that ambiguous center-waist sword placement. Clearly wear ONE COMPLETELY SHEATHED KATANA on the OUTSIDE of his LEFT HIP (the VIEWER'S RIGHT). The whole weapon must look like a separate continuous object suspended from his obi by a visible short blue cord or belt loop at the SIDE of the waist. The entire dark navy scabbard, including its closed gold end cap, should be visible OUTSIDE the body silhouette, slanting gently downwards and outwards alongside his left thigh. The hilt and round gold guard should also be outside the torso silhouette, beside the hip. Do not draw any exposed blade. No part of the sword may penetrate, emerge from, disappear into, or overlap the center of his abdomen. Leave the center obi and stomach unobstructed, with cloth visibly continuous. Adjust the hand closest to the katana so it rests gently on the hilt AT THE SIDE OF THE HIP, rather than crossing the stomach. The other arm can remain loosely folded.
Preserve the EXACT silver-white hair, blue half-ponytail ribbon, clear blue eyes, cool reserved expression, white-navy-cobalt ornate robe, all costume ornaments, chibi proportions, detailed soft painted anime illustration style and transparent alpha. Full-body illustration including feet. Only change the sword/scabbard attachment and the necessary hand placement. One sheathed katana only. No second sword, no blade, no wound, no scenery, no text, no opaque background.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this exact chibi Yamato Takeru illustration. Change ONLY where the sword-side hand grips the weapon.
The katana is correctly fully sheathed at his outside LEFT hip, on the VIEWER'S RIGHT. KEEP its existing location, diagonal angle, navy-blue scabbard, gold end cap, hilt, gold guard and attachment to the obi exactly as they are.
MOVE the character's LEFT HAND slightly DOWN, BELOW THE ROUND GOLD SWORD GUARD, so his fingers and thumb clearly wrap around the UPPER NAVY-BLUE SCABBARD / SAYA. The hand must be HOLDING THE SCABBARD, not the sword handle. Show the entire blue-wrapped sword hilt ABOVE the guard completely FREE of the hand, unobstructed and clearly separate. The hand may rest around the navy scabbard just below the guard, as if steadying the hanging sheath at his hip. Relaxed natural fingers, five fingers, anatomically clear single hand. No hand on the hilt or on the gold guard. The sword must remain fully sheathed and still hung from the side of the belt. No exposed blade, no sword crossing or entering the abdomen.
Preserve every other detail exactly: face and cool expression, luminous blue eyes, silver hair and blue ribbon, white-blue ornate clothing, the other folded arm, whole-body pose, original fine anime chibi linework and shading, transparent alpha. No background, no text, no extra sword.
